svg.title: The best published energies by system size, one panel per method family
svg.desc: tensor network: 141 energies; transformer / ViT: 37 energies; CNN / ResNet: 50 energies; RNN: 62 energies; RBM: 107 energies; mean field: 45 energies; backflow / Pfaffian: 124 energies; other NQS: 16 energies; classic VMC: 125 energies; FCIQMC / CC: 77 energies; AFQMC / GFMC: 74 energies; VQE / circuit: 51 energies; other: 67 energies
svg.text: The best energies by system size, one panel per method family
Each panel colours one family's energies over all the others in grey and joins the family's best energy at each size. A method
that only ever ran at one size is a lone mark.
